description: CHART 12 - 100% stacked bar (basic idiom). Where Australians buy their organic groceries: major supermarkets, other supermarkets, and specialty, independent, online and direct sellers. Why one stacked bar: three parts of one whole (they add up to 100%), shown compactly with exact labels; length along one bar is easier to compare than pie angles. Blues because shoppers are 'people and money' in the page's colour system, darkest for the biggest share. Transforms: tidy the category name; text colour is white on the dark segments.

title.text: Share of organic grocery sales by type of store, 2024/25

transform.calculate: datum.channel == 'Specialty independent online and direct' ? 'Specialty, independent, online and direct' : datum.channel

layer.description: Layer 1: the three segments of the bar, in the order biggest to smallest.
Layer 2: the % in the middle of each segment (stack: zero with bandPosition puts it at the centre).
